justification: The chunk-loss guard counts map legends as rule-bearing, so City of Sydney s6 (pages 25-36 are maps) was refused twice although the reader rightly returned nothing. AI_FIGURE_PAGES lets a person name checked figure pages for one run; off unless set, like --allow-section-loss. The OpenRouter-key test now also unsets DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: named pages are not skipped or empty input is not empty
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Ignoring the parsed ranges fails the new test; restored, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/ai_extractor.py: used live for CoS s6 review read with AI_FIGURE_PAGES=25-36 on 2026-10-19

pre_impl.existing_data: held chapters' review rows lack the intro/scope sentences printed on the PDF pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: page coverage judges a page by most of its rule lines, so an intro paragraph can be lost on a passed page
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends the reader after _reread_skipped_pages; reuses page_coverage.running_lines and doubled_text

functions.name: figure_pages_override
functions.input: the AI_FIGURE_PAGES value from the process environment
functions.output: set of page numbers the chunk-loss guard skips
functions.if_none: an empty set, so the guard behaves exactly as before

break_it.scenario: the setting is not present in the environment
break_it.what_happens: the guard refuses a lost chunk as before

break_it.scenario: a malformed range like x-y in the setting
break_it.what_happens: it is ignored and valid pages still apply

break_it.scenario: both DeepSeek keys are removed in the key test
break_it.what_happens: the missing-key error is raised as intended

post_merge.manual_verify: CoS s6 review read passes the chunk guard with AI_FIGURE_PAGES=25-36
